description: A two-panel figure in which both panels are stacked-column plots decomposing flow stress into strengthening-mechanism contributions, drawn on identical axes: x = "True strain" (0.0-0.4, ticks at 0.0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4), y = "True stress(MPa)" from 0 to 1600 with major ticks every 200. (a) is marked "RT" (room temperature) and its legend lists "Measured True Stress" (black square-marked line), σ_dis (pink hatched block), σ_GB (teal hatched block) and σ_f (blue hatched block). Five stacked bars sit at true strain ≈0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.25 and 0.3; the black measured-true-stress curve rises from about 300 MPa to just under 800 MPa, and the top of each stack (σ_f + σ_GB + σ_dis) coincides with the measured curve. (b) is marked "LNT" (liquid nitrogen temperature) and adds a fourth mechanism, σ_twin (yellow cross-hatched block), plus a magenta circle-marked line with a grey shaded band between it and the measured curve; roughly six bars extend to true strain ≈0.42, the yellow σ_twin block appearing only at the highest strains, and measured flow stress reaching ≈1440 MPa. No numeric data labels are printed on any bar or point.

observations.observation: Both panels plot "True stress(MPa)" (linear, 0-1600, major ticks every 200) against "True strain" (0.0-0.4, ticks at 0.0/0.1/0.2/0.3/0.4) with a black square-marked curve labelled "Measured True Stress".
Panel (a) is annotated "RT" and its legend contains exactly four entries: Measured True Stress, σ_dis, σ_GB and σ_f.
Panel (b) is annotated "LNT" and its legend contains five entries: Measured True Stress, σ_twin, σ_dis, σ_GB and σ_f.
In (a) the summed height of each stacked bar (σ_f + σ_GB + σ_dis) coincides with the black Measured True Stress curve, indicating the mechanism sum reproduces the measured flow stress at RT.
Panel (b) contains an additional magenta circle-marked line lying below the measured curve, with a grey shaded band between the two curves that widens as strain increases.
The yellow σ_twin block is absent from the low-strain stacks in (b) and becomes visible only in the highest-strain stacks.
The measured true stress attained at the largest plotted strain is roughly twice as high in (b) (approaching the 1400-1600 MPa gridlines) as in (a) (just below the 800 MPa gridline).
No numerical data labels are printed on any bar or marker; all values must be read against the y-axis gridlines.
The caption states that (a) is room temperature (RT) and (b) is liquid nitrogen temperature (LNT) conditions and that the panels show contributions of various strengthening mechanisms to flow stress.
The caption states that the shaded area in (b) represents the contribution of twins; the image shows a grey shaded band but does not label it.
The citing text asserts that the calculated contributions of dislocations and twins to the flow stress are in excellent agreement with the measured values in Fig. 13(a and b).
The citing text asserts that at room temperature only a small number of deformation twins form at high strains, so deformation is primarily controlled by dislocation hardening.
The citing text asserts that at liquid nitrogen temperature a synergistic effect between dislocation hardening and twinning operates, with both contributing to strain hardening.

The citing text states that the contribution of a small amount of ferrite to the flow stress is very minimal, less than 10 MPa, so ferrite is neglected and flow stress is computed on a fully austenitic structure, yet σ_f still appears as a legend entry in both panels.

subfigures.description: Stacked-bar decomposition of flow stress at room temperature (labelled "RT"): true stress (MPa, 0-1600) vs true strain (0.0-0.4). Legend: Measured True Stress (black line with square markers), σ_dis (pink hatch), σ_GB (teal hatch), σ_f (blue hatch). Five stacks at true strain ≈0.05-0.3 whose summed height tracks the measured curve from ≈300 MPa to just below 800 MPa.

Same construction at liquid nitrogen temperature (labelled "LNT"), with an extra legend entry σ_twin (yellow cross-hatch) and a magenta circle-marked line bounding a grey shaded band below the black Measured True Stress curve. About six stacks to true strain ≈0.42; the yellow σ_twin block appears only at the highest strains and measured true stress reaches ≈1440 MPa.
